summary: Properties::union incorrectly propagated is_alternation_literal() from alternatives, classifying (?:z|xx)@|xx as a simple alternation of literals. The literal optimizer then encountered a nested alternation where it expected a literal and panicked during regex compilation. The fix requires each alternative to satisfy is_literal(). The fix-added regression_fuzz::todo test exercises this compilation under the default test target with default features.
expected_failure: internal error: entered unreachable code: expected literal, got
